conflicts.issue: Repository segmentation is conditional design guidance. Preserve the approved function-owned polyrepo consumer model; this checklist grants no monorepo migration authority.
Load balancing, scalable storage, redundancy and service discovery depend on actual workload and deployment model; they are not required purchases or deployments for every repository.
Microservices are explicitly conditional and can conflict with simplicity and limited maintainer capacity.
Cloud and self-hosted Server obligations have different operational owners, permissions, features and evidence. Their repeated occurrences must not be collapsed into universal applicability.
Open collaboration and visibility must respect authorized access, security reporting confidentiality and data residency obligations.
Backup presence and tested restoration are different claims; automation does not itself establish recoverability.
External communication and enterprise feature usage are review options, not blanket credentials, integration or cost authorization.
